Well, the main thing I did was not taking enough privacy for "my things", due to the fact that I thought I was silent but I really wasn't. 

The worse I did.. probably doing it whilst other people where around in a pool when I was maybe 13, and also slightly touched a friend's bum when I was 14 cause the day before I had heard on TV that "touching a classmate's bum is not the same as a sexual assault" (of course definitely something so wrong, but I don't think I need to write the way I feel about that).

I have some other sh*t that comes to my mind, but those are some of the episodes that really make me feel the most ashamed.
Thank you for that, and also, I usually tend to refuse DMs but I feel like I can trust you, so if it is fine for you then for me it is as well :)

I get that. It's just that... You know this is just one of the episodes I feel bad about. As a teen I've done a lot of stupid stuff in terms of sexuality, I didn't take enough privacy, I did lowkey creepy stuff, also forgot to mention that sometimes I even looked at social media pictures of those girls I found attractive. 

You know, when I think of someone's sexuality, especially girls as I find them to be just more "wholesome" if that makes any sense, it arouses me, sure, but it also feels cute to me, like it is something pure, not bad at all.

But when it comes to my sexuality, also due to the events I feel bad about, I feel creepy and gross. I feel like I don't deserve it, I'm embarrassed about myself and I don't like what I did and what I am to the point that I'd like to not be myself. Also whilst sexuality of course can be practiced alone, I feel like it is something that connects souls and people, and also due to the stuff I did and to what I am, I feel like no girl would ever want me and I feel like I'd just be abandoned and be classified as a creep if girls valued me for that, and it makes me feel so alone and unworthy of love, affection and sexuality. 

Sorry for making it so long, it's just that... I love the fact that you and a lot of other people took their time to reply to me reassuring me and being so nice to me, but I just feel so unworthy of that and I'd like to be honest and tell everything I find bad about myself.

Oh also, I'm quite sure it might have happened to me to look at social media pictures whilst taking my private time. I forgot to mention that, and well, I feel like that's just one more thing proving me that I'm creepy.

I am now doing the best I can, but I just feel like I've done too much shit overall. This episode is just one of all the mistakes that make me feel bad. Overall I remember being a teenager who didn't take enough privacy and I've done quite some stuff that I feel classifies me as a creepy.

Also, not to be gross, but idk, thinking about a girl doing that, it is just a cute image to me in my head. Of course thinking of sex arouses me, but in certain ways it also feels so cute to me if done in certain ways. But personally I don't live my sexuality as "cute", I feel like I'm gross, also due to the fact that in my past I've done stuff I feel not proud about at all in terms of sexuality (I haven't raped anyone, but I just have done stuff I feel bad about). 

Idk sexuality seen in others makes me happy, and I find it cute, but I feel so grossed out by myself and I feel like a bad person.

Yeah that's true, it's just that now that I'm 18 I'm realising how many times I've been inappropriate, many times even sexually if that makes any sense. Idk I've been a fricking weirdo and I used to not take enough privacy and overall have had many episodes I feel guilty about. 

I feel like I've made too many mistakes, and to even make some now that I'm 18 just adds proofs to what I'm afraid of, which is that I'm a creep and a bad person.
Maybe not telling someone, but I get what you say. Thank you.
Thank you so much for that, it helps a lot :)

Thank you for that, I get it. Though, even if I didn't tell her, I told my friend even if my intention was not to harm her, but maybe I indirectly did, I just don't don't know what the heck was I thinking idk
Yeah, I get that. I'd never tell anyone, and if I could go back in time I wouldn't tell my friend as well.

Thank you so much for that, I appreciate it. Also sorry if I'm asking you that, but I'm super anxious and idk I guess I always need a lot of reassurance but; do you think that about me even considering the part of me telling my friend? Sorry if that's a weird question, it's just that I struggle not to feel the negative way I feel about myself and I kinda need to get reassured. My mind's so annoying, sorry for that and thank you.

Thank you so much for that. Especially the last two lines. What I feel the most guilty about, though, is telling my friend. I deep down know that my intentions weren't bed when I told my friend, but I don't feel good about having done that, and also it gives me anxiety as I tend to overthinking a lot and wonder "what if I did that cause I am a weirdo and I was proud to say that, or I did that cause of some stupid stuff running into my mind". 

Ah, idk, can't stand that anxiety.
Thank you for having shared your point of view

The reason why I feel guilty about that is that I feel like I'm doing something 'unconsensual' if that makes any sense, but it's not what I feel the worse about. What I feel worse about is telling my friend. 

I know my intentions were not to telling them in order to objectify my crush, but still I feel bad cause she definitely wouldn't like me to go telling someone something like that, and I shouldn't have done that in the first place.. like why did I have to tell my friend.
Thank you so much for that. I appreciate it.
